### `adminList`

Lists every row for a service administrator, a page at a time (page numbers from 1, at most 100 rows a page), filtered and sorted by the declared fields.

A query.

Input:

| Field       | Type                                                                                  | Notes                   |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| `filter?`   | `{ type?: string; enabled?: boolean }`                                                |                         |
| `sort?`     | `{ field: "type" \| "key" \| "version" \| "updatedAt"; direction?: "asc" \| "desc" }` |                         |
| `page?`     | `integer`                                                                             | 1 to 1000000; default 1 |
| `pageSize?` | `integer`                                                                             | 1 to 100; default 20    |

Output: `{ items: { id?: string; type?: string; key?: string; data?: Record<string, unknown>; version?: integer; enabled?: boolean; updatedAt?: string }[]; total: integer; page: integer; pageSize: integer; totalPages: integer }`.
